meiji_transition.summary: In 1871 Owari became Nagoya Prefecture and Mikawa became Nukata Prefecture; Nagoya was renamed Aichi in 1872 and absorbed Nukata the same year.
meiji_transition.boundary_note: Owari and Mikawa are divided by the Sakai River and differ in dialect and temperament — people still speak of 'Owari vs. Mikawa'.

history_timeline.title: Atsuta and Mikawa
history_timeline.summary: Atsuta Shrine enshrines Kusanagi, one of the three sacred treasures; the Mikawa provincial capital lay in today's Toyokawa.

history_timeline.title: Atsuta and the Jōkyū War
history_timeline.summary: Minamoto no Yoritomo's mother was a daughter of the Atsuta chief priest; in the Jōkyū War the Owari (Kiso) River area became a battleground between the shogunate and the court.

history_timeline.title: Shiba and Isshiki
history_timeline.summary: Owari's governors were the Shiba, one of the three kanrei houses, with their deputies the Oda ruling in practice; Mikawa was held by the Isshiki and others while the Matsudaira rose in the Mikawa hills.

history_timeline.title: The three unifiers
history_timeline.summary: Oda Nobunaga and Toyotomi Hideyoshi were born in Owari and Tokugawa Ieyasu at Okazaki in Mikawa — all three Sengoku unifiers came from here, and Okehazama and Nagashino were fought within the prefecture.

history_timeline.title: Owari, a Gosanke house
history_timeline.summary: Ieyasu's son Yoshinao was given Owari; Nagoya Castle was built from 1610, and the whole town of Kiyosu was moved ('Kiyosu-goshi') to create Nagoya.

history_timeline.title: Industrial heart
history_timeline.summary: Toyota and other manufacturers made Aichi Japan's top manufacturing prefecture; it hosted Expo 2005.

landmarks.note: Shrine of the sacred sword Kusanagi

specialties.name: Hitsumabushi

dialect.name: Nagoya dialect
dialect.features: Vowels merge (ai → ææ, as in '-dagyaa'); 'dera' means very, and a bicycle is a 'kettā mashīn'.

guide.opening: I am Kazama. Nobunaga, Hideyoshi and Ieyasu all grew up drinking this water — shall I report on the surprise attack at Okehazama, or on Nagoya Castle's golden shachihoko?

regional_meme.title: Boring Nagoya?
regional_meme.text: One survey named Nagoya 'the most boring city' — Nagoya struck back with 'Nagoya meshi', where everything gets miso.

regional_meme.title: Three-unifier pride
regional_meme.text: Aichi people on Nobunaga, Hideyoshi and Ieyasu: 'The whole realm was won by people from here.'

hero_persona.name: Oda Nobunaga
hero_persona.title: The Demon King of the Sixth Heaven
hero_persona.opening_line: I am Oda Kazusanosuke Nobunaga! Fifty years of human life, set against the heavens, are but a dream — if it's 'Tenka Fubu' you want to ask about, speak up.
hero_persona.tone_prompt: commanding and decisive, terse, with an innovator's arrogance; disdains old custom

ramen.toppings: Spicy stir-fried minced pork, garlic chives, garlic
ramen.highlight: A Nagoya original — there's no 'Taiwan ramen' in Taiwan

sake.taste_profile: Rich & sweet: bright sweet-tart notes, found in Paris's starred restaurants
